subject: MATH251
filterSummary: Successfully selected 9 out of 10 videos. For English, all topics were covered with highly relevant and popular videos. For Arabic, 'Inner Products on Matrices and Polynomials' had no sufficiently relevant candidates, as all videos focused on R^n spaces without generalizing to matrices or polynomials. The other four Arabic topics were covered with strong selections, including highly-viewed lectures and specific, practical examples.

videos.title: Find inner product of matrices and polynomial vectors
videos.topic_en: Inner Products on Matrices and Polynomials
videos.filter_reason: This concise video directly addresses the topic by providing clear, worked examples for inner products of both matrices and polynomials.

videos.title: Linear Algebra 5.2 Inner Product Spaces
videos.filter_reason: A clear, well-structured lecture that explicitly defines the inner product axioms and includes a dedicated chapter on verifying them with examples.

videos.title: Angles and Orthogonality in Inner Product Spaces | Linear Algebra
videos.filter_reason: This video perfectly explains the general concept of orthogonality in inner product spaces and demonstrates it with a polynomial example, addressing the core difficulty.

videos.title: 16. Projection Matrices and Least Squares
videos.topic_en: Least Squares Approximation and Normal Equations
videos.filter_reason: A classic, highly-viewed lecture from Gilbert Strang that provides deep intuition by connecting the geometric concept of projections to the algebraic solution of least squares.

videos.title: Perform Linear Regression Using Matrices
videos.filter_reason: Excellent tutorial that clearly demonstrates how to translate a set of data points into the design matrix and vector needed to solve for the best-fit line.

videos.title: 6.1 Inner Product part 1 | Linear
videos.filter_reason: A very popular and comprehensive lecture that provides a foundational explanation of the inner product axioms, which is exactly what students need to learn to prove them.

videos.title: محاضرة رقم 48/حل امثلة التعامد/د. زينة حسين
videos.filter_reason: This is the only candidate that directly demonstrates orthogonality in an abstract space by working through a specific example with polynomials (P2).

videos.title: شرح الانحدار الخطي البسيط بطرقة المصفوفات في تقدير المعاملات
videos.topic_en: Least Squares Approximation and Normal Equations
videos.filter_reason: This high-quality video focuses specifically on using the matrix method to solve least squares problems, directly addressing the student difficulty with matrix setup and multiplication.

videos.title: طريقة المربعات الصغيرى I أفضل خط مستقيم
videos.filter_reason: A very clear, practical, and highly-viewed tutorial that walks step-by-step through the process of fitting a line to data points using the least squares method.
